contents: Equipment-reported yield and full-inspection good yield did not agree, so true process defects and inspection misclassification had to be separated under one basis. I aligned the yield denominator and measurement criteria, then managed owners, deadlines, local 4M+2E retests, and decision criteria on the same cells. I contributed to the team result of stabilizing monthly average good yield from about 40% to 98.7% and directly revised the MSA criteria, SOP, QCP, P-FMEA, and inspection standards.

contents: Product development and SAT were complete, but the actual new product was not reflected in laser, AI-vision, and X-ray conditions, while line interlocks and repeated motion remained dependent on manual operation and temporary recipes. Two 100-cell full-process lots and a final 50-cell continuous run validated the limited-production setup, followed by management approval and handoff of the field standards.

contents: Without dedicated tabless equipment or jigs, existing 4695 equipment and manual work had to meet the safety and functional CTQs of a PROTO A sample. Narrowed failure modes across about 100 trials and confirmed A-sample feasibility through Hi-Pot, IR, formation, capacity, and life evaluation on five functional samples.
